description: Locale-aware text filtering in the Svelte 5 data grid. Set filterLocale to a BCP-47 tag and the grid normalises text with NFD decomposition, diacritic stripping and locale-aware lowercasing, so cafe matches Café, munch matches München and, in tr-TR, istanbul matches İstanbul. The same pipeline drives global search and every column's contains, equals and starts-with operator.

faq.question: How do I make the filter ignore accents?
faq.answer: Set filterLocale on <SvGrid>, for example filterLocale='en'. Values and queries are decomposed with NFD and stripped of combining marks before comparison, so cafe and Café match.

faq.question: Why does the locale matter for lowercasing?
faq.answer: Some languages have casing rules that plain toLowerCase gets wrong. Turkish has the dotted and dotless I, so under tr-TR the grid lowercases with that locale and istanbul matches İstanbul.

faq.question: Does this apply to the column menu filters too?
faq.answer: Yes. Global search and the contains, equals and starts-with operators of every text column share the same normalisation.
